pr_title: [Wasm] Ensure monovm_initialize is called on startup and address other startup items
pr_body:
This PR addresses: 

- Calling monovm_initialize matches how other mono platforms init themselves (Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/39074)
- Set the entry assembly (Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/38994)
- Make sure the assembly location is set to empty for assemblies that are loaded from memory (Fixes https://github.com/dotnet/runtime/issues/39650)

That'll use image->filename, which is NULL ;-).

Do you have any suggestions on alternatives in the runtime?

issue_context.title: Assembly.GetEntryAssembly() returns null on Browser WASM
issue_context.body:
Assembly.GetEntryAssembly() returns null within Browser WASM. Also occurred when running `exePath_UserLevelNone` from `ConfigurationManagerTest.cs` on Browser. Similar to #21319 

Failure text:
```
[FAIL] System.Tests.AppDomainTests.FriendlyName
Assert.Equal() Failure
          ↓ (pos 0)
Expected: System.Runtime.Extensions.Tests
Actual:   DefaultDomain
          ↑ (pos 0)
   at System.Reflection.RuntimeMethodInfo.Invoke(Object obj, BindingFlags invokeAttr, Binder binder, Object[] parameters, CultureInfo culture)
```

Related Code
```
public string FriendlyName
        {
            get
            {
                Assembly? assembly = Assembly.GetEntryAssembly();
                return assembly != null ? assembly.GetName().Name! : "DefaultDomain";
            }
        }
```
